reviewed_views.name: overview
reviewed_views.observation: Four buildings, two baths, terraced hillside and connecting routes visible. Muted sky covers frame without diagnostic text. Upper edge of terrain preserved; near front-left terrain clips slightly at image border.

reviewed_views.name: top_down
reviewed_views.observation: 100m footprint, zigzag access route, two stair connections, bridge and two baths read clearly. Perspective top-down view, not orthographic.

reviewed_views.name: village_path
reviewed_views.observation: Actual close view shows building facade, rail, steps, bath rim and subtle steam. Thin path sheet edges and a localized angular apron/terrain transition remain visible.

reviewed_views.name: hot_spring
reviewed_views.observation: Stone rim and opaque turquoise water are visible with soft vertical vapor above both water and grass; bathhouse and upper watercourse provide context.

reviewed_views.name: hot_spring_timed_04s
reviewed_views.observation: Same camera. Vapor strength/position and water detail differ locally from base capture.

reviewed_views.name: hot_spring_timed_08s
reviewed_views.observation: Same camera. Vapor is less pronounced above grass than base capture; water pattern differs. No fluid simulation claim.

temporal_interpretation: Visible localized vapor/water changes and verified Time/Panner/Sine graphs jointly support artistic animation. Pixel differences alone are not considered proof because temporal rendering also varies.
limitations: Small path-edge/terrain slivers remain; geometry audit documents residual7.16mm intrusion.
Stream intentionally disappears below bridge and bank transition.
Opaque water and crossed steam cards are artistic approximations.
